profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Team Lead
profile.summary: Frontend developer with a background in product design. I love team collaboration where I bring my passion for sustainability,  learning, and finding solutions. As an avid hiker and creative, so when I'm not coding you can find me in the mountains making videos about the PNW.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Angular · Software Development · Front-End Development

positions.title: JavaScript Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Guiding students in the process of learning JavaScript, building component architecture using Vue and React, debugging, and using Git and GitHub.

positions.title: Full-time Student
positions.description:
Career Track | Advanced Full Stack Software Development
◍ Front-end Development using React & Redux
◍ Back-end Development using MongoDB, Mongoose, Express, & Node
◍ TDD utilizing Mocha, Chai, Jest, & Enzyme
◍ UX design utilizing mobile first, SASS, & CSS Grid
◍ Algorithms & big O notation

Bootcamp 2 | Intermediate Software Development
◍ Front-end development using jQuery
◍ Back-end development using PostgreSQL, Express, & Node
◍ Single page applications & MVC architecture
◍ Asynchronous programing
◍ Restful APIs

Bootcamp 1 | Fundamentals of Software Development
◍ Semantic HTML5/CSS
◍ Fundamental JavaScript & ES6 Syntax
◍ Object-Oriented Programming
◍ Data types & structures
◍ Git & GitHub

positions.title: Industrial Designer
positions.description: Developed and designed 3D models, renderings, artwork, and technical drawing for custom retail displays. Worked in collaboration with designers, salespeople, and manufacturing to problem solve and develop high quality products for our clients.

positions.title: Freelance Graphic Designer
positions.description: Collaborated with clients to create print media, branding concepts, and multi-page layouts using the Adobe Creative Suite. Ensured design and print quality, while staying within time constraints of the project.

positions.title: Adjunct Instructor
positions.description: Instructed an undergraduate course in the fundamentals of AutoCAD. Responsibilities included the preparation of lectures, projects, and lab experiences, along with ongoing student mentoring and supervision.

positions.title: Special Projects Craftsperson & Designer
positions.description:
Daily Tasks

◍  Develop post-production documents including archive and installation manuals for clients and prepared 3D models to aid in the work-flow of the CNC and woodworking departments.

Major Projects

◍  Paul McCarthy - Sculptures, Houser & Wirth, New York.
     ⦁  Enhanced efficiency by streamlining production and Rhino processes.
     ⦁  Advanced from apprentice to assembly lead.

◍  Urs Fischer - URS FISCHER, Museum of Contemporary Art, Los Angeles.
     ⦁  Liaison between the remote production team and headquarters.
     ⦁  Project documentation and interdepartmental communication.

volunteerExperiences.description: Helps build an accepting community for children, families, and young adults affected by HIV and help them with the  persistent stigma of our culture. Main responsibilities are watching over and listening to campers, leading group activities, and supporting fellow counselors.
Organizes hikes, camping trips, and meet-ups. Moderates online content. Educates women about the outdoors through meet-ups and online forums.
